criteria.text: Electron produces a native macOS notification when an armed agent turn finishes, matching Flutter's user-visible behavior.
criteria.reason: Automated U1 host and U2 renderer behavior passed. Packaged/native U3 remains separately untested; this is not proof of visible OS delivery.

criteria.text: Electron produces native permission/question notifications unless the user is already viewing that exact ask in the foreground.
criteria.reason: Automated U1 host and U2 renderer behavior passed. Packaged/native U3 remains separately untested; this is not proof of visible OS delivery.

criteria.text: Notifications are deduplicated per completion/ask and stale ask notifications are withdrawn when resolved.
Clicking a notification focuses/restores Rhythm and opens the relevant agent session; activation also works when the app was not ready when the click arrived.
criteria.reason: Automated U1 host click-routing behavior passed. Packaged/native U3 remains separately untested; this is not proof of actual OS click delivery or visible navigation.

criteria.text: Notification permission is explicitly requested and denial/unsupported/platform errors fail soft without blocking the agent session.
criteria.reason: On macOS, Electron exposes no main-process requestPermission API; the first renderer arm explicitly asks main to show one fixed priming Notification, which is the platform request trigger. Main reports show as granted, an explicit permission-denied failure as denied, no observable result/platform failure as unknown, and Notification.isSupported() false as unsupported. Other platforms use the same best-effort probe without claiming a system prompt.

criteria.text: Renderer content cannot create arbitrary native notifications: Electron main owns trusted notification text, validation, dedupe, cancellation, and navigation.
Existing approval-notification behavior and authentication-generation invalidation remain intact.
Focused host tests cover permission, presentation, dedupe, cancellation, stale-generation rejection, and click routing.
Visible macOS Notification Center banner and sound.
criteria.reason: No human observation of a visible Notification Center banner or sound was performed; automated U1/U2 results do not establish OS delivery.

criteria.text: Real Notification Center click and System Settings/Focus behavior when AX access is unavailable.
criteria.reason: No real OS notification click or System Settings/Focus inspection was performed.
After-quit activation is unsupported and was not tested; no behavior is claimed.

criteria.text: Packaged candidate + real sandbox automated path proves actual preload/main bridge, event arrival, show attempt/log, cancellation, and session routing.
criteria.reason: The packaged candidate plus real-sandbox U3 bridge path was not run; actual preload/main bridge, event arrival, show attempt/log, cancellation, and session routing remain unverified.
